creator: Alexander Terp
description: Since 2026-10-05 each --key is its own write, KEY_GAP (50 ms) after the pane's last, slept on the pane's single writer thread (crates/muster-daemon/src/writer.rs Writer::write). Input::Reply (answers to terminal queries a program waits on), a person's typing and doorbell rings queue behind it, so N keys stall them ~N x 50 ms; check_sent_keys puts no cap on the count (100 keys = 5 s). Consider letting Reply bypass the pacing and capping keys per send. Also (speculative, review): doorbell press_again checks someone_typed_at, which is set only on a write, so during the pacing sleeps a Return-only ring could queue behind a dialog answer.
title: pane send --key paces the whole pane's input, replies to terminal queries included
